race.comment: I'M CONFUSED (14) has continued to improve at the jump-outs, winning the most recent of those at Cranbourne earlier in the month. Her stable has a good record when trekking their team to this circuit, and from a good gate, she can make her first race day start a winning one. SCORPION (2) overcame an early check, and a tough trip from a wide gate to finish a gritty fourth at Albury 3 weeks ago. He is peaking at the right time, and having an extra 225m is the key for us. Hard to beat, especially from a superior gate. BAR LA LA (7) has not been too far away in each of her 2 starts this season, and she dons the blinkers for the first time, which often does the trick. Stick with her for all top 4 combos. BOOTS OFF (5) had been given plenty of education at the jump-outs prior to finishing an encouraging third on debut at Donald 12 days ago. He won't have to improve by much to be winning a race like this. ESTIVAL (8) was beaten by a wide gate, and a slow start at Wangaratta 11 days ago.
